body.title: Prove acceptance and pure boundaries; document maintainer handoff
body.summary: Add proposed sources/__tests__/acceptance.test.ts and isolation.test.ts, reuse S001 fixtures without changing their semantics; document reviewed-profile/staging sequence and limitations in corpus README.
acceptanceChecks: Mixed local source end-to-end admits only eligible bytes with exact revisions/attribution/modifications; complete export inventory covers all third-party obligations and S001 preflight accepts using explicitly synthetic S003 coverage fixtures.

Mutation regressions fail for stale profile, source refs, notice omission, lineage/output digest, role swap and noncomputable candidate; original-only and multi-source derived cases pass when complete.

Compile fresh pure corpus/sources entries and run policy/notices/assessment with I/O forbidden; Git entry separate; all corpus tests and strict build pass under supported Node; preserve durable test/build evidence for daemon review.
Document no migration needed for new sc3 module, maintainer-reviewed profiles and future S003/S004 handoff; request independent daemon code review after build and explicit completion approval.
Every preceding task has named tests executed at its own gate; this task adds acceptance and boundary evidence, then runs the accumulated regression suite.

tests.name: candidate-roundtrip admits only eligible material and exports complete notices
candidate-roundtrip validates original-only and multi-source derived packages
pure-boundary executes pure source modules with I/O forbidden
strict-build compiles source eligibility and passes the full corpus regression suite
